verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that generates a fix plan, applies fixes and verifies them. It runs in coding assistants (/snyk-fix, /snyk-batch-fix) or via `snyk fix --agentic` as a human-in-the-loop flow, and DeepCode AI claims 85%-accurate autofixes. Separately, Snyk Open Source supports fix workflows via pull requests, but the evidence never says the AI agent drafts PRs; the AI fixes are applied locally, and community users describe the automated dependency PRs as noisy. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that AI-generated fixes for SAST/Code findings are opened as reviewable pull requests, and independent hands-on corroboration of AI fix quality.
